Galactic City Defense.description: Third-person shooter across Coruscant rooftops, the Jedi Temple and Tatooine. Play as Commander Cody or Commander Fox. VR ready.

galactic legends.description: Arena fighting game: pick a legend, pick a weapon, last one standing wins.

Galactic-Playground.description: 2D physics sandbox full of Jedi, Sith, troopers, droids and starships. Build it, break it, blow it up.

galactic-tower-defense.title: Galactic Tower Defense
galactic-tower-defense.description: Hold the line across three sectors. Build and upgrade 10 units, fire off Legendary Protocols, and survive the Hollow Sovereign.
